rows.label: monosodium L-glutamate
rows.hook: gives a savory, brothy taste to soups, snack chips and takeout dishes

rows.label: formaldehyde
rows.hook: is a pungent gas famous for keeping school dissection specimens from rotting

rows.label: diethyl ether
rows.hook: was an early surgical anesthetic that put patients to sleep

rows.label: methanol
rows.hook: is nicknamed wood alcohol and can cause blindness if swallowed

rows.label: chloroform
rows.hook: is the sweet-smelling liquid movie villains press on a rag to knock people out

rows.label: sucrose
rows.description: disaccharide made of glucose and fructose
rows.hook: forms the white crystals people stir into coffee, extracted from cane and beets

rows.label: sodium hypochlorite
rows.hook: disinfects swimming pools and household surfaces, and must never be mixed with ammonia

rows.label: ammonium nitrate
rows.hook: is a white salt that can detonate violently when stored in huge quantities

rows.label: naphthalene
rows.hook: has a sharp odor people associate with old attic trunks and grandma's closet
